summary: Tests for `kb view`. The 'esc (attribute-safe)' block does NOT import esc: it regex-extracts the single line `const esc = ...;` out of VIEW_TEMPLATE (src/kb/view-template.ts) and evaluates it with new Function, because esc lives inside the template's client script and is not exported. So the test is coupled to that line's source shape — keep it one line starting `const esc =` and ending `;`, or the extraction throws on a null match. It pins that esc escapes quotes as well as & < >, since esc feeds double-quoted attributes (data-dir="${esc(path)}") and CodeQL flagged the old & < > only version (js/incomplete-html-attribute-sanitization).
